query:
SELECT rp.id, rp.paidDate, rp.paidAmount, rp.paymentMethod
FROM receivablePayments rp
JOIN partners p ON rp.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%' AND rp.paidAmount = 0.50;
